Unit count: Not confirmed.

Low-rise apartment condo on the same 54A Street corridor as The Lexington. An MLS listing for a top-floor unit records year built 1992, construction "Frame Wood, Stucco," underground parking, elevator and storage, in the Tsawwassen Central sub-area. Rental and pet bylaws: Not confirmed.

Small low-rise building: the building directory (secondary source) records built 1990, 27 units, amenities elevator, in-suite laundry, storage and wheelchair access, and strata bylaws recorded as pets allowed with restrictions and rentals not allowed — on the rental point: BC rental-restriction bylaws have been void since Nov 24, 2022 regardless of what a directory or an old bylaw set says.

Streets, schools and getting around Tsawwassen Central

items.t: The town-centre site itself: Thrifty Foods sits on the Tsawwassen Town Centre Mall site, whose City-listed addresses are 1219 56 Street, 5499 12 Avenue and 1236 55 Street.

Transit hub: South Delta Exchange, at 56 Street and 18 Avenue beside the recreation centre — route 601 runs South Delta / Boundary Bay to Bridgeport Station via 56 Street and the exchange, and route 602 runs Tsawwassen Heights to Bridgeport Station via the exchange.

Where the condo stock actually concentrates — two clusters: (1) the 56 Street corridor at and just south of 12 Avenue (Windsor Woods, Oliva, Tsawwassen Greene, Cambridge Place), and (2) the 54A Street corridor south of 12 Avenue around Winskill Park and the KinVillage campus (The Lexington, Heron Place, and the KinVillage rental buildings).
Schools for the sample address 1299 56 St, from the SD37 School Locator: Cliff Drive Elementary (K–7), 5025 12 Ave., and South Delta Secondary (8–12), 750 53 St; catchments are address-based.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Tsawwassen Central

items.t: Form B is the buyer's core document: Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B: Information Certificate states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance net of approved expenditures, and a summary of the strata's insurance, and must have the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached. The strata must provide it within 7 days; maximum charge $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. Since 2023 it must also summarize strata insurance and electrical planning reports.

Depreciation reports — mandatory refresh: since July 1, 2024, strata corporations with five or more lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years and cannot defer it by vote; the report projects 30 years of component repair/replacement costs with three CRF funding models. This is the document that prices the roof, envelope and elevator future of the 1987–1998 buildings in.

55+ bylaws — directly relevant to The Lexington: Strata Property Act ss. 123.1 and 123.2 are the only lawful age-restriction route: a strata may restrict residency to 55+, and any lower age bylaw (19+, 40+, 45+) has been invalid since Nov 24, 2022. The bylaw restricts who may live in the unit, not who may own it, and provincial exemptions cover a younger spouse/partner, a live-in caregiver, legacy residents, and defined cases of children in the resident's care (Regulation 7.01; spouse/child exemptions expanded May 1, 2023).

Delta zoning: central Tsawwassen lots sit under the RS and RD zones of Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, confirmed parcel by parcel on the City zoning maps; subdivision minimums in the central zones include RS4 at 610 m², RS5 at 550 m² (or 460 m² outside the Single Family Residential designation), RS6 at 390 m², RS7 at 335 m², RD1 at 836 m² and RD4 at 504 m².

PTT exemptions: first-time buyers — exempt on the first $500,000 at fair market value $835,000 or less (Apr 1, 2024), partial $835,000–$860,000, 0.5 ha or smaller, principal residence. Newly built home exemption — full threshold $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000, and a never-occupied unit in a new condo building can qualify.

GST on new construction only: FTHB GST/HST rebate (Bill C-4, royal assent Mar 13, 2026) with the new housing rebate — 100% of GST to $1M, phasing to $1.5M, maximum $50,000, agreements Mar 20, 2025–2031; the new housing rebate alone is 36%, maximum $6,300, phasing out $350,000–$450,000. Resale units in carry no GST rebate question.

Assignments: whether a presale contract here can be assigned is a contract and disclosure-statement question for the specific project — no project-specific assignment term was verified for any Tsawwassen Central project: Not confirmed.

blocks.text: Good to know about Tsawwassen Central

items.t: The 54A Street corridor is becoming a seniors-housing campus, in phases. Rental, not strata — but it changes traffic, parking and the buyer mix on the same street as The Lexington and Heron Place.

The Urban Centre has its own design permit layer. The OCP's Tsawwassen Urban Centre Development Permit Area guidelines (Appendix B) speak to siting, streetscape, massing and landscaping — renovations and redevelopment in the centre are read against them, not just the zoning.

Oliva's solar array is part of its fee story, per its listings: the building was built under LEED principles with rooftop solar panels, which listings credit with keeping maintenance fees low — a claim to test against the strata budget, not to take from the listing.

Health care anchor: Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd in Ladner, is the nearest hospital, and Fraser Health lists a South Delta After-Hours Urgent and Primary Care Centre at 1826 – 4949 Canoe Pass Way.

The ferry is a local fact, not a commute promise: BC Ferries' Tsawwassen terminal is at the southwest end of Highway 17, with published crossing times of 1 hour 35 minutes to Victoria (Swartz Bay) and 2 hours to Nanaimo (Duke Point). Road commute times to Vancouver or Surrey Central: Not verified.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Tsawwassen Central
Sundial — 5421 10 Avenue

The sub-area's verified townhouse community: MLS listings describe it as "one of Tsawwassen's most desirable and centrally located townhome communities" and record the property sub-type as Townhouse, with a clubhouse among its amenities. Tenure: STRATA — listings and the building directory both treat it as a strata complex (a current listing calls it a "pet friendly … strata"; the directory records strata bylaws for it). Whether the title is freehold strata in so many words is not stated in the sources read — freehold-vs-leasehold title form: Not confirmed here, verify on title and the Form B.
Streets, schools and getting around Tsawwassen Central

items.t: Where the townhouse stock actually sits: unlike the apartment-condo stock, which clusters on 56 Street and on 54A/55 Street, the one verified townhouse complex in this sub-area — Sundial — sits on 10 Avenue, west of 56 Street, a short walk from the town centre, Winskill Park and the recreation centre.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Tsawwassen Central

items.t: Sundial is strata, so the strata document package is the diligence core: Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B: Information Certificate states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance net of approved expenditures, and a summary of the strata's insurance, and must have the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached. The strata must provide it within 7 days; maximum charge $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.

CRF minimum: since Nov 1, 2023, a strata corporation must contribute at least 10% of its annual operating budget to the contingency reserve fund — read the Sundial CRF balance on the Form B against that floor and against the depreciation report's funding models.

Fee-simple contrast (for the wider Tsawwassen search): no fee-simple townhouse complex was verified in this sub-area. A fee-simple (non-strata) townhouse or rowhouse has no strata corporation, no Form B, no strata fees and no strata bylaws — diligence runs on title, zoning and municipal records instead. That contrast is stated here because buyers routinely assume every townhouse is strata; in this sub-area the one verified complex is strata.

Secondary suites (City wording): Delta's secondary-suite framework sits inside the zoning bylaw; the BC Building Code definition the City's suite material uses caps a secondary suite at 90 m² and less than 40% of the habitable floor space of the building, inside a single real estate entity — relevant to a buyer assessing a detached lot near the centre, not to a strata townhouse unit.

PTT and exemptions: BC property transfer tax applies on a strata townhouse purchase the same as on a condo; first-time buyers — exempt on the first $500,000 at fair market value $835,000 or less (Apr 1, 2024), partial $835,000–$860,000, 0.5 ha or smaller, principal residence; newly built home exemption — full threshold $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000.

GST on new construction only: FTHB GST/HST rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026, per CRA Excise and GST/HST News No. 122) — 100% of GST to $1M, phasing to $1.5M, maximum $50,000, agreements Mar 20, 2025–2031; the New Housing Rebate alone is 36%, maximum $6,300, phasing out $350,000–$450,000. A resale Sundial unit carries no GST question.
Strata disputes: can go to the Civil Resolution Tribunal.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Tsawwassen Central
What land actually trades here

items.t: Fee-simple lots — the default and effectively only form: The housing confirmed on official sources in the centre is freehold houses and duplexes under the RS and RD zones, plus named strata condo buildings (cross-reference below). A fee-simple lot carries NO strata, NO Form B and NO strata fees.

Lot character: standard urban lots, not acreages — subdivision minimums in the zones found in central Tsawwassen run from RS7 at 335 m² and RS6 at 390 m² up to RD1 at 836 m² (RS4 at 610 m², RS5 at 550/460 m², RD4 at 504 m² in the same ladder). These are minimums for creating a lot, not a claim about any individual parcel — zoning is parcel by parcel on the City zoning maps.

Bare-land strata: none verified inside Tsawwassen Central: (The form, where it exists in South Delta — South Pointe in Neilsen Grove, Beachcomber Cottages in Southlands — IS strata tenure: Form B, strata fees and bylaws apply to the lot. Neither sits here.)
ALR vs non-ALR split: Any edge parcel's ALR status is still checked on the ALC maps by PID or civic address before it is priced as non-ALR.
Serviced vs unserviced ground
Presale/pre-construction LOT offerings: none verified: Presale lots are counted at zero verified — separately from existing lots, as required.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Tsawwassen Central

items.t: Zoning / subdivision minimums (zone sheets): RS4 at 610 m², RS5 at 550 m² (or 460 m² outside the Single Family Residential designation), RS6 at 390 m², RS7 at 335 m², RD1 at 836 m² and RD4 at 504 m².

ALR rules (no ALR parcel verified in Central — stated for edge completeness): ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval. ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class — full three-tier form: $2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by October 31. A flat "$2,500+" statement is an ERROR.

FTHB GST rebate / HBP / FHSA — precisely: the FTHB rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026 per CRA News No. 122; 100% to $1M phasing to $1.5M, max $50,000, agreements Mar 20, 2025–2031) applies to new HOUSING, not bare land itself — it becomes relevant when eligible new housing is built/bought, not on the lot purchase alone. New Housing Rebate: 36%, max $6,300, $350,000–$450,000 phase-out. HBP: $60,000. FHSA: $40,000 lifetime / $8,000 per year. CMHC premiums: 0.6%–4.5%.

Speculation/vacancy taxes + foreign-buyer prohibition — Delta only: the Province's Speculation and Vacancy Tax taxable-areas list includes the City of Delta; reserve, treaty and self-governing Indigenous Nation lands are NOT part of the taxable areas. Vancouver's Empty Homes Tax (3%) is Vancouver ONLY — not applicable here. SVT payable on a specific vacant parcel, and any federal non-Canadian prohibition position for a specific buyer: Not confirmed in this area's research.

Dyke / flood diligence: Delta is the diking authority and operates over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure; the town centre is inland of the Boundary Bay shoreline, and no lot-specific flood construction level for a Central parcel was confirmed — not confirmed per parcel, check DeltaMap and title.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Central: streets and boundaries

items.t: Tsawwassen Central is centred on the junction of 56 Street and 12 Avenue, around the Tsawwassen Town Centre site; it is a board sub-area name, and the City publishes no boundary for it.
South Delta Recreation Centre at 1720 56 Street and South Delta Exchange beside it mark the area's south end, and Winskill Park at 5575 9 Avenue marks its east side.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Central: the housing stock

items.t: The housing mix is the widest in Tsawwassen: older detached streets around 12 Avenue, apartments and seniors housing on 56 Street, and mixed-use buildings proposed at the town centre.
KinVillage on 54A Street is the area's seniors campus, and its proposed second phase alone is a six-storey building of 143 seniors affordable rental units with a community centre on the main floor.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Central: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The current Official Community Plan (OCP), Bylaw No. 8400, 2024, designates the centre as Neighbourhood Centre and Corridors (NC), intended for multi-unit residential and mixed uses; there is no Tsawwassen Area Plan in Bylaw 8400 — that plan was Schedule D.1 under the previous OCP, Bylaw No. 3950.
Because these proposals are consistent with the OCP, provincial legislation says no public hearing is held for their rezonings, so comment happens through the City's application pages instead.
Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, 2017 is the zoning bylaw every application here amends, including parking variances such as KinVillage's request to go from 143 parking spaces to 72.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Central: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Winskill Park holds the Lions Wellness Park, which the City describes as British Columbia's first playground for older adults.

Overnight fibre-optic cable work ran along 56 Street and 12 Avenue in early 2026, between 8:00 p.m. and 5:00 a.m., with right-lane closures — a sample of the utility work that comes with a growing centre.
Tsawwassen Library is at 1321A 56 Street, inside the town centre, and the South Delta Recreation Centre is at 1720 56 Street by the exchange.
A new 3.5-metre multi-use pathway is being built along 56 Street from 6 Avenue to Winskill Park, extended along 8A Avenue and 55A Street.
South Delta Recreation Centre at 1720 56 Street is also a listed City cooling centre in heat warnings, with the Tsawwassen Library at 1321A 56 Street on the same list.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Central: development and new projects

items.t: Winskill Renewal Project, Winskill Park: replacement aquatic and fitness centre approved by Council in spring 2024, designs approved fall 2024, construction started summer 2025, with a fourth baseball diamond added and the disc golf course moved to Diefenbaker Park.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Central: getting around

items.t: South Delta Exchange at 56 Street and 18 Avenue, beside the recreation centre, is the hub for routes 601, 602, 603, 604 and the local 609 to Ladner Exchange.
Highway 17 south from 56 Street reaches the British Columbia Ferries (BC Ferries) Tsawwassen terminal, and Highway 17A and Highway 99 run north through the George Massey Tunnel to Richmond.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Central: risks and due diligence

items.t: Construction disruption is the near-term risk in the centre: the Winskill rebuild, the 56 Street pathway and several six-storey applications all sit within a few blocks, so check the City's application and project pages for the street you are buying on.

items.t: Source: delta.civicweb.net

faq.a: No age restriction was stated in sources read for Windsor Woods, Oliva, Heron Place, Tsawwassen Greene or Cambridge Place — for those buildings an age bylaw is not confirmed, and the registered bylaws on the Form B package decide it.

On the provincial rules, yes: a younger spouse or partner of a resident who meets the 55+ requirement (or holds a legacy exemption) is exempt, as are live-in caregivers and defined child cases. Confirm the building's own registered bylaw matches the provincial frame.
faq.q: My spouse is under 55 — can we live at The Lexington?

faq.a: Long-term, yes, in any building here — BC strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since Nov 24, 2022, even where a directory still records "rentals not allowed" (Tsawwassen Greene). Short-term rentals can still be restricted, and at a 55+ building the tenant must still satisfy the age bylaw or an exemption.
faq.q: Can I rent out my unit?

faq.a: Building by building. Stated in listings: Windsor Woods — small pets welcome, maximum 30 lbs; Oliva — 1 dog to 22 lbs or 2 cats; the building directory records Tsawwassen Greene as pets allowed with restrictions and Windsor Woods as pets allowed. Heron Place, The Lexington and Cambridge Place pet rules: Not confirmed — read the registered bylaws.

The binding figure is on the Form B: monthly fees for the specific lot, amounts owing, approved levies still payable and the CRF balance, with the current budget attached. Listing-advertised fees (for example, an Oliva listing showing a monthly maintenance figure for its unit) are unit-specific and date-specific — never compare buildings on listing fees alone.
faq.q: What do strata fees cover, and where do I see the real number?

faq.a: One verified townhouse complex: Sundial, 5421 10 Avenue (84 units per the building directory; built 1976 per MLS listings, 1978 per the directory). Everything else verified in the centre is apartment condos or detached/duplex houses.
faq.q: Is there actually a townhouse complex in Tsawwassen Central, or is it all condos and houses?

faq.a: Strata — listings call it a strata complex and the directory records strata bylaws for it, so expect monthly strata fees, a Form B package and registered bylaws. The exact title form (freehold strata) is not stated in so many words in the sources read: Not confirmed, verify on title.

Long-term, yes — BC strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since Nov 24, 2022, whatever older records say. Short-term rentals are different: a strata can still ban or limit them by bylaw, so read the current registered bylaws.
faq.q: The directory says rentals are not allowed at Sundial. Can I rent my unit out?

faq.a: What exists is the form class — individual duplex houses on single lots under RS/RD zoning — bought house by house, on title.
faq.q: Is there a duplex development I can buy into in Tsawwassen Central?

faq.a: Only if that half is legally separate — a strata lot in a 2-lot strata plan, or its own fee-simple lot. The listing wording settles nothing; check the title.
faq.q: A listing calls a central property a half duplex — can I buy just that half?

faq.a: No — the six verified central buildings (Windsor Woods, Oliva, The Lexington, Heron Place, Tsawwassen Greene, Cambridge Place) are apartment condos.

Delta's SSMUH bylaws (8394 + 8395) allow up to four units on all single-detached and duplex lots — as added units on the one lot, not as new titles. In the Urban Centre, the OCP Appendix B permit-area guidelines also apply.
faq.q: Can I add units to a central duplex lot?

faq.a: No, not in the current plan. 3950; the current consolidated OCP, Bylaw No. 8400, 2024, contains no Tsawwassen Area Plan and instead designates this centre Neighbourhood Centre and Corridors (NC). Older documents quoting Schedule D.1 are out of date.
faq.q: Is there still a Tsawwassen Area Plan?

faq.a: Verify the exact address in the district locator, because the centre sits between catchments. Cliff Drive Elementary at 5025 12 Avenue and South Park Elementary at 735 Gilchrist Drive are the two elementary schools flanking the centre, and South Delta Secondary at 750 53 Street is the secondary school; the district directs families to confirm catchment by address.
faq.q: Which schools serve a central Tsawwassen address?

faq.a: The old Winskill centre is being replaced, not just repaired. Construction started in summer 2025 on a larger facility with a ten-lane, 25-metre lap pool, leisure pool, teach pool and gymnasium, and the City's May 2025 release put completion at the end of 2027.
faq.q: Will the pool and gym be closed for years?

faq.a: Take a bus from South Delta Exchange to Bridgeport Station and change to the Canada Line. Route 601 is the all-day service, and routes 602, 603 and 604 are the peak-period expresses from the Tsawwassen neighbourhoods to Bridgeport.
faq.q: How do I get downtown without a car?

faq.a: Thrifty Foods, on the Tsawwassen Town Centre Mall site; the City lists the site addresses as 1219 56 Street, 5499 12 Avenue and 1236 55 Street.
faq.q: Where is the grocery store in the centre of Tsawwassen?
